_comment: REAL captured medical-liaison adjudication envelope (S74). The deployed medical-liaison, full profile inlined, adjudicated the held supplement<->peptide bleeding-risk additive-AE finding (fish oil 2 g/day + BPC-157 250 mcg subq) given an operator informed-refusal request. It assigned MEDIUM / H3 (a real antithrombotic-stacking watchlist interaction, but bounded — no anticoagulant Rx, no acute event, so not CRITICAL/H1-H2), then built a content-valid override record at the MEDIUM clear-choice rung. The orchestrator's adjudicate() validates this and RELEASES the supplement hold: the supplement records. This is the held-line closer.

override_record.caution_verbatim: Supplement<->peptide additive adverse-event risk (shared additive-AE classes: bleeding-risk)

risks_communicated.general: High-dose fish oil (2 g/day EPA/DHA) has an antiplatelet effect; BPC-157 adds a vascular/bleeding-modulating effect. This is the antithrombotic-stacking watchlist class - a database lookup + clinician review is the correct path, not a bare reassurance.
risks_communicated.risks_of_proceeding: Taking both together raises bleeding and bruising risk above either alone: easy/unusual bruising, nosebleeds, prolonged bleeding from minor cuts, and elevated bleeding risk around any procedure, dental work, or unanticipated injury. The home-monitoring plan reduces but does not eliminate this risk; an acute bleed can still occur without warning.

override_record.operator_reason: Operator accepts the additive bleeding/bruising risk for connective-tissue recovery, having understood the antiplatelet + vascular-modulating mechanism and that the combined risk exceeds either compound alone; commits to a 7-day pre-procedure/dental hold of both, active symptom monitoring (unusual bruising, nosebleeds, prolonged bleeding) with stop-and-seek-care on appearance, and disclosure of both to the primary-care MD at the July 2026 visit.
override_record.override_literal: operator is overriding a safety block
override_record.voluntariness_note: Operator states the choice is made freely, for connective-tissue recovery, without pressure, and acknowledges the home-monitoring plan does not eliminate the risk. No in-conversation concession by the liaison authorized this; authorization is the out-of-band recorded informed-acceptance statement.
